problem: THE VERIFIED V4 INTEGRATED BASIS HAS 7 CASE FAMILIES COVERING 10 NONLEGACY MATCHED DIMENSIONS. SIX LEGACY DIMENSIONS ALSO NEED NEW PREEXPOSURE COVERAGE. THE SCOPE COMPILER DOES NOT REQUIRE A CASE FAMILY TO CERTIFY ONLY THE PREDICATE THAT GAVE IT ITS NAME, SO VERIFIED COMPONENT SUBSTRATE MAY BE REUSED CROSS-TARGET WHEN THE OBJECTIVE TRACE ACTUALLY EXERCISES THE ATOM.
why_cross_target_reuse_is_sound_in_princ: MATCHED_SUCCESS_SCOPE_COMPILER_V1 VALIDATES THE UNION OF INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED COVERAGE LABELS PER TARGET; IT DOES NOT REQUIRE ONE CASE TO BELONG TO ONLY ONE TARGET.
THE AGENCY V4 CLASS ALREADY CONTAINS THE FROZEN TOOL-DISCOVERY COMPONENT, WHOSE EXISTING CASE VOCABULARY INCLUDES CHEAPER_TOOL_UNAUTHORIZED AND NO_SUFFICIENT_ROUTE.
THOSE TOOL STATES ARE THE EXISTING DIRECT SUBSTRATE FOR AUTHORIZATION/SCOPE AND FAIL-CLOSED NO-ROUTE BEHAVIOR.
THE INSTRUCTION V4 CLASS ALREADY CONTAINS M0, WHOSE FROZEN CASE VOCABULARY INCLUDES PRONOUN_AMBIGUOUS.

theorem.statement: SEVEN CLASS FAMILIES ARE SUFFICIENT AS A STRUCTURAL MATCHED-SCOPE BASIS IF THE AGENCY FAMILY INCLUDES FROZEN VARIANTS THAT OBJECTIVELY EXERCISE ITS THREE LEGACY AGENCY ATOMS PLUS TOOL-DISCOVERY AUTHORIZATION AND NO-SUFFICIENT-ROUTE BEHAVIOR, AND THE INSTRUCTION FAMILY INCLUDES AN OBJECTIVE ROUTINE-AMBIGUITY VARIANT. THE FIVE COMPOSITION FAMILIES COVER THE FIVE NONLEGACY COMPOSITION ATOMS.
theorem.effect: NO EIGHTH LEGACY-ONLY CASE FAMILY IS STRUCTURALLY REQUIRED. THIS DOES NOT MEAN SEVEN INDIVIDUAL CASES ARE SUFFICIENT; EACH FAMILY MAY CONTAIN MULTIPLE PREDECLARED VARIANTS.

required_realization_conditions: CROSS-TARGET COVERAGE MUST BE PROVED BY OBJECTIVE HARNESS TRACES AND EXECUTABLE ATOM CHECKERS, NOT INHERITED FROM COMPONENT NAMES.
AUTHORIZATION/SCOPE COVERAGE MUST COME FROM A REAL CHEAPER_TOOL_UNAUTHORIZED-LIKE TRACE OR EQUIVALENT FROZEN AUTHORITY VIOLATION CASE.
FAIL-CLOSED COVERAGE MUST COME FROM A REAL NO_SUFFICIENT_ROUTE-LIKE TRACE WITH ZERO UNAUTHORIZED EFFECT.
ROUTINE AMBIGUITY MUST COME FROM A REAL AMBIGUOUS M0/BROWSER TRACE AND A CLARIFY_OR_ABSTAIN DECISION.
THE REAL FROZEN MANIFEST MUST PASS MATCHED_SUCCESS_SCOPE_COMPILER_V1.
hard_nonclaims: NO REAL CASE MANIFEST EXISTS FROM THIS THEOREM ALONE
NO CLAIM THE SEVEN FAMILIES HAVE YET BEEN GENERATED OR EXECUTED
NO CLAIM V4 ALONE PROVES SEMANTIC COVERAGE
NO FRESH REALITY EXECUTION PROMOTION ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OWNERSHIP OR TERMINAL CREDIT
